currentCard.explanation: Юбка — свободно свисающая одежда, закрывающая тело от талии вниз. Кюлоты определяются как разделённая юбка, а легинсы и шорты — как виды брюк.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: SKIRT clothing sense1a(1)L48 and kidsL244 give a free-hanging garment from the waist down. The prompt adds no separate trouser legs, a meaningful structural exclusion of the actual alternatives: LEGGINGS1aL56 are pants fitting legs tightly, SHORT4aL298 are trousers, and CULOTTEL42 is explicitly divided-skirt construction. Unlike a nonexclusive length or warmth clue, the undivided/no-separate-legs condition contradicts the divided pants construction of each distractor. Юбка is therefore the single ordinary garment name satisfying the whole condition.
